sloka: हतप्रवीरा व्यथिता राक्षसेन्द्रचमूस्तदा।जगामाभिमुखी सा तु कुम्भकर्णसुतो यतः ।। ६.७६.३५ ।।
transliteration: hatapravīrā vyathitā rākṣasendracamūstadā।jagāmābhimukhī sā tu kumbhakarṇasuto yataḥ ।। 6.76.35 ।।

translations.english: Then many heroes died, Rakshasa king's army was distressed and went towards where Kumbhakarna's son was fighting.
